The refinement identity gives $$q_F(x)=\sum_i\bigl(a_iq_F(a_i)+b_iq_F(b_i)+a_ib_i\bigr).$$ Therefore the finite Gauss sum factors as $$\sum_{x\in H_1(F;\mathbb F_2)}(-1)^{q_F(x)}=\prod_i\sum_{a,b\in\mathbb F_2}(-1)^{a q_F(a_i)+b q_F(b_i)+ab}=2^g(-1)^{\sum_iq_F(a_i)q_F(b_i)}.$$ The left side depends only on $q_F$, not on a basis, so the exponent defining the Arf value is basis-independent.
